subject: Finishes that connect living spaces
hook: Living-room furniture made to match the rest of your home
gbp:
Struggling to find living-room furniture that sits well with your kitchen or flooring? SUPERIO Furniture makes bespoke living-room furniture for homes in Stone and the surrounding Staffordshire area, in finishes chosen to connect your rooms.

We make alcove units, sideboards, bookcases, media walls and display storage to measure, so each piece fits its space and shares a finish palette with the rest of the house. Options include oak-effect, charcoal, black woodgrain, matt white and matt black, in matt, super matt, gloss, painted or slatted styles, with antique gold or matt black handles.

How it works:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation where we look at samples against your floor and existing furniture
- Measuring and an itemised quote with no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, checked before it leaves
- Delivery and installation by our own team

Learn more about what we make, then arrange a consultation.
